mapper.select: SELECT id, student_id, question_id, error_cause_id, error_count, last_wrong_at, resolved, resolved_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM wrong_record WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND question_id = #{questionId} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(wr.id AS CHAR) AS id, CAST(wr.question_id AS CHAR) AS questionId, q.type AS questionType, q.stem AS stem, q.answer AS correctAnswer, wr.error_count AS errorCount, CAST(wr.error_cause_id AS CHAR) AS errorCauseId, ec.name AS errorCauseName FROM wrong_record wr INNER JOIN question q ON q.id = wr.question_id AND q.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN error_cause ec ON ec.id = wr.error_cause_id AND ec.deleted = 0 WHERE wr.student_id = #{studentId} AND wr.deleted = 0 ORDER BY wr.last_wrong_at DESC
